faqs.question: Which plan is best for getting immediate customer inquiries?
faqs.answer: For immediate high-intent leads, our Google Ads Management (₹7,500/mo) and Meta Ads (₹3,000/mo) or Performance Marketing (Meta ₹5,000 / Google ₹10,000) deliver measurable customer inquiries within days.

faqs.question: What is included in the Reel Shoot (Starting ₹6,000)?
faqs.answer: It includes an on-location video shoot featuring scripted creative concepts, professional lighting, directional coaching, and 3-5 edited high-converting reels/shorts.

faqs.question: How does the AI Videos service work (Starting ₹599)?
faqs.answer: Our team leverages state-of-the-art AI video tools to create engaging 30-45 second video reels with realistic voiceovers, dynamic visuals, and branded captions optimized for social media ads.

faqs.question: How fast will my 10 Social Media Graphics (₹500) be delivered?
faqs.answer: Initial drafts are typically delivered within 2-3 business days. You receive 10 custom high-resolution graphics matching your brand colors and typography, with one round of revisions included.

faqs.question: Can I combine multiple services into a custom package?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can select multiple individual plans or contact our team for a tailored combo package combining website design, social media content, and paid advertising.
